6
Nteaseɛnam nnan no
1 # Sak 1.8; Adi 6.2-8 Na mesane memaa m’ani so mehwɛe, na hwɛ, na nteaseɛnam nnan firi mmepɔ mmienu no ntam reba, na mmepɔ no yɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ mmepɔ. 2Teaseɛnam a ɛdi kan no, apɔnkɔ kɔkɔɔ na ɛwɔ ho, na teaseɛnam a ɛtɔ so mmienu no, apɔnkɔbire na ɛwɔ ho, 3na teaseɛnam a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no, apɔnkɔfufuo na ɛwɔ ho, na teaseɛnam a ɛtɔ so nnan no, apɔnkɔ nworonnworan ahoɔdenfoɔ na ɛwɔ ho. 4Na mebisaa ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔne me rekasa no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn ne yeinom, me wura? 5#Sak 4.14 Na ɔbɔfoɔ no bua see me sɛ: Yeinom ne ɔsoro mframa nnan a ɛfiri adi firi deɛ wɔde wɔn ho gyinagyinaa asase nyinaa wura anim hɔ ba no. 6Deɛ apɔnkɔbire wɔ ho no, wɔfiri adi kɔ atifi fam asase so, na afufuo no firi adi di wɔn akyi, na nworonnworan no firi adi kɔ anafoɔ fam asase so; 7#Sak 1.10 na ahoɔdenfoɔ no firii adie no, na wɔrepɛ anante akyin asase so; na ɔkaa sɛ: Monkɔ na monkɔkyini asase so. Na wɔkɔkyinii asase so. 8Ɛnna ɔteaa mu frɛɛ me kasa kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Hwɛ, wɔn a wɔrefiri adi akɔ atifi fam asase soɔ ama me honhom ho asane no wɔ atifi fam asase no so.
Ɔsɔfo panin no denhyɛ
9Na AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: 10Gye sika ne dwetɛ firi atukɔfoɔ a wɔfiri Babel baeɛ; Heldai, Tobia ne Yedaia nkyɛn, na ɛda no ara kɔ kɔhyɛne Sefania ba Yosia fie. 11Na fa yɛ abotire fa bɔ Yehosadak ba Ɔsɔfopanin Yosua ti, 12#Sak 3.8 na ka kyerɛ no sɛ: Sɛ asafo AWURADE seɛ nie: Hwɛ, ɔbarima bi a “Ban” ne ne din, na ɔbɛfefɛ n’ananmu, na ɔbɛsi AWURADE asɔredan no. 13#Dwom 110.4 Ɔno ara na ɔbɛsi AWURADE asɔredan, na ɔno ara na ɔbɛsoa animuonyam, na watena n’adwa so adi hene, na wadi sɔfoɔ n’adwa so, na asomdwoeɛ agyinatuo bɛtena wɔn baanu no ntam. 14Na abotire no nyɛ nkaeɛ adeɛ mma Helem ne Tobia ne Yedaia ne Sefania ba Hen, AWURADE asɔredan no mu.
15Na akyirikyirifoɔ bɛba abɛsi AWURADE dan no bi, na moahunu sɛ asafo AWURADE na ɔsomaa me mo nkyɛn; na sɛ motie AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn a, yei bɛnya aba mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na mesane memaa m’ani so mehwɛe, na hwɛ, na nteaseɛnam nnan firi mmepɔ mmienu no ntam reba, na mmepɔ no yɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ mmepɔ. Teaseɛnam a ɛdi kan no, apɔnkɔ kɔkɔɔ na ɛwɔ ho, na teaseɛnam a ɛtɔ so mmienu no, apɔnkɔbire na ɛwɔ ho, na teaseɛnam a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no, apɔnkɔfufuo na ɛwɔ ho, na teaseɛnam a ɛtɔ so nnan no, apɔnkɔ nworonnworan ahoɔdenfoɔ na ɛwɔ ho. Na mebisaa ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔne me rekasa no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn ne yeinom, me wura? Na ɔbɔfoɔ no bua see me sɛ: Yeinom ne ɔsoro mframa nnan a ɛfiri adi firi deɛ wɔde wɔn ho gyinagyinaa asase nyinaa wura anim hɔ ba no. Deɛ apɔnkɔbire wɔ ho no, wɔfiri adi kɔ atifi fam asase so, na afufuo no firi adi di wɔn akyi, na nworonnworan no firi adi kɔ anafoɔ fam asase so; na ahoɔdenfoɔ no firii adie no, na wɔrepɛ anante akyin asase so; na ɔkaa sɛ: Monkɔ na monkɔkyini asase so. Na wɔkɔkyinii asase so. Ɛnna ɔteaa mu frɛɛ me kasa kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Hwɛ, wɔn a wɔrefiri adi akɔ atifi fam asase soɔ ama me honhom ho asane no wɔ atifi fam asase no so.

Na AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: Gye sika ne dwetɛ firi atukɔfoɔ a wɔfiri Babel baeɛ; Heldai, Tobia ne Yedaia nkyɛn, na ɛda no ara kɔ kɔhyɛne Sefania ba Yosia fie. Na fa yɛ abotire fa bɔ Yehosadak ba Ɔsɔfopanin Yosua ti, na ka kyerɛ no sɛ: Sɛ asafo AWURADE seɛ nie: Hwɛ, ɔbarima bi a “Ban” ne ne din, na ɔbɛfefɛ n’ananmu, na ɔbɛsi AWURADE asɔredan no. Ɔno ara na ɔbɛsi AWURADE asɔredan, na ɔno ara na ɔbɛsoa animuonyam, na watena n’adwa so adi hene, na wadi sɔfoɔ n’adwa so, na asomdwoeɛ agyinatuo bɛtena wɔn baanu no ntam. Na abotire no nyɛ nkaeɛ adeɛ mma Helem ne Tobia ne Yedaia ne Sefania ba Hen, AWURADE asɔredan no mu.
Na akyirikyirifoɔ bɛba abɛsi AWURADE dan no bi, na moahunu sɛ asafo AWURADE na ɔsomaa me mo nkyɛn; na sɛ motie AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn a, yei bɛnya aba mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
